## Reference Answer
> Are there examples of how to leverage providers other than OpenAI?

The Microsoft Agent Framework provides a MultiModelService sample in the dotnet/samples/GettingStarted/Workflows/_Foundational directory that demonstrates how to configure and use multiple AI model services, including AWS and Anthropic. This foundational sample shows patterns for switching between or orchestrating different language models in a workflow.

You can use ChatClientAgent with arbitrary IChatClient implementations. Those exist on nuget for AWS, Anthropic, Gemini, Hugging Face, ONNX Runtime GenAI, llama.cpp (LlamaSharp), Ollama, and more.
